newsitem.title: JAPAN: Advantest shares up on expected profits.
newsitem.headline: Advantest shares up on expected profits.

text.p: Shares in Advantest Corp jumped on Friday morning, helped by growing expectations of the measuring instruments producer's corporate earnings, traders said.
The share price was up 180 yen at 5,380 yen at 0122 GMT, on volume of 412,000 shares.
Advantest shares have climbed for five trading days.

Nikko Research Center Ltd said that Advantest's new testing device drew attention, which prompted Nikko Research to revise the company's earnings forecast upward for the business year that ends in March 1998.
On Wednesday, Nikko Research upgraded Advantest to a "1" from its previous "2".

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
